summary: Fresh-import smoke verification for Website-Sekolah (SMA Negeri 1 Laguboti). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (public /settings/org/org-structures, super_admin login & /auth/me, dashboard stats, classes, library/config/stats, achievements, attendance, posts, object-storage /upload via SMANSALA proxy, AI book summary /books/{id}/ai-summary via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). Frontend: login page renders school name/NPSN/address with all expected data-testids; login with seeded super_admin succeeds and lands on dashboard with widgets rendering; all core modules (School Info, Classes, Library, Schoolgram, Prestasi/Achievements, Presensi Barcode/Attendance) load without crashes or error UI; public pages /struktur-organisasi, /galeri, /presentasi, /dokumentasi, /profil-sekolah, /ppdb all render content as expected. End-to-end wiring to SMANSALA integration proxy (object storage + AI) is working.

issues: Sidebar/hero school-name header is slightly truncated in the dashboard sidebar for 'SMA NEGERI 1 LAG…' (nice-to-have: use tooltip or wrap)

action_items: Non-blocking: backend uses model string 'gpt-5.4' in _ai_text (server.py line 3585). AI summary endpoint currently returns 200 with content via SMANSALA proxy, so it works, but confirm the intended model name — standard LlmChat examples use 'gpt-4o-mini' / 'gpt-5' etc. If model id is invalid, cached results may be masking it; consider a safer default like 'gpt-4o-mini'.

Non-blocking: console shows 401 for /api/auth/me on public and login routes — this is expected (frontend probes auth). To reduce noise, skip the /auth/me call when no token is present in localStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4024 lines — well above 700-line guideline. Should be split into routers/modules (auth, library, attendance, ppdb, storage, ai, exports).
put_object/init_storage use synchronous `requests` inside async FastAPI handlers; blocks the event loop under load (consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor).
AI model id 'openai/gpt-5.4' at line 3585 is unusual; verify it is a supported model for SMANSALA LlmChat.
A number of GET endpoints use `.to_list(5000)` / `.to_list(1000)` without pagination (library_stats, list_books, etc.) — fine for seed data but will degrade at scale.
